list.name: Tunnel reconnect
list.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(cloudflared_tunnel_tunnel_register_success{job=~"$job"}[2m])) > 0 and on (pod) (time() - max by (pod) (process_start_time_seconds{job=~"$job"}) > 120)

description: cloudflared: tunnel status, request outcomes, throughput, requests in flight and edge connections. Collapsed rows hold error codes, edge round-trip time and locations, control calls and runtime cost.

panels.title: Tunnel
panels.description: Connections to Cloudflare on the worst replica against the usual count. Fewer is DEGRADED; none is DOWN.

panels.title: Success
panels.description: Completed responses that were not server errors (5xx).

targets.expr: 1 - (sum by () (increase(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) or (min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) * 0)) + sum by () ((min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) unless cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"5.."} offset $__range) or (min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) * 0))) / (sum by () (increase(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) or (min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)) + sum by () ((min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) unless cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job"} offset $__range) or (min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)))

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests Cloudflare sent through the tunnel in the selected range.

panels.title: Not completed
panels.description: Requests that ended without a complete response: visitors leaving, or an origin that could not be reached.

panels.title: Relayed
panels.description: Bytes the tunnel sent in the selected range, approximately: responses to the edge and requests to the origin.

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: Connections to Cloudflare re-registered after start-up; each one dropped and came back.

panels.title: Requests per hour
panels.description: What happened to each request. Not completed: no full response, mostly visitors leaving. WebSocket and other: upgraded or still open.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second the tunnel relays, in either direction.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests open through each replica. Streams and WebSockets set the floor.

panels.title: Edge connections
panels.description: Connections each replica holds to Cloudflare. A dip is a dropped connection.

panels.title: Errors by status code
panels.description: Error responses in the selected range per status code, most frequent first.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, (sum by (status_code) (increase(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range]) or (min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range]) * 0)) + sum by (status_code) ((min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range]) unless cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"[45].."} offset $__range) or (min_over_time(cloudflared_tunnel_response_by_code{job=~"$job",status_code=~"[45].."}[$__range]) * 0))) > 0))

panels.title: Tunnel · round-trip time, locations & control calls
Edge round-trip time
panels.description: Round-trip time to Cloudflare's edge, smoothed by QUIC: typical and worst connection. Reported with the QUIC transport only.

panels.title: Edge locations
panels.description: Cloudflare data centres the tunnel is connected to now, by connection count.

panels.title: Control calls per hour
panels.description: Calls to Cloudflare that register or drop edge connections and push config, and those that failed.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(cloudflared_rpc_client_failures{job=~"$job"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(cloudflared_config_local_config_pushes_errors{job=~"$job"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) or vector(0))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU per cloudflared replica, as a share of one core.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines per replica. They track requests in flight; growth with flat traffic is a leak.
